description:
Comment "SHORTS" to get all five skills.

You can now make viral animated reels in seconds with Claude Code.

Nobody edited or animated these shorts.

Every single frame was written in code by Claude Code.

It's a free project on GitHub called Claude Faceless Shorts Creator.

It comes with five skills that teach Claude how to make a short.

You clone it, run one install and open the folder in Claude Code, and it finds all five skills.

Then you add your ElevenLabs key for the voice and the sound effects.

The captions land on the exact spoken word.

Now you give it one sentence, like make a short about the water cycle for kids.

It writes the plan first, then builds it.

Once you say go, it animates every scene, checks the frames at phone size, adds the voice and renders the video.

Its 2D animation skill has styles built in, like Memphis, neo brutalism or glassmorphism.

So instead of paying an editor for every short, you type one sentence and Claude builds the whole thing.

#claudecode #remotion #facelessyoutube #aianimation #youtubeshorts
